Keralam skin specialists warn against harmful fairness creams promoted by influencers

Skin specialists in Keralam have issued an alert regarding fairness creams that promise instant results, warning that some products may contain harmful ingredients. Functionaries of the Indian Association of Dermatologists, Venereologists, and Leprologists emphasized the importance of ensuring beauty products do not have adverse effects on the body. Reports indicate that influencers have promoted mercury-laced creams, with one instance cited where a 17-year-old girl in Keralam allegedly suffered kidney damage after using such a product. The Keralam Minister has called for action against influencers promoting fake cosmetic products.
